node.statement: From the root hypotheses alone, ||Phi Delta-Delta||_cb<=2*epsilon: since Delta is UCP, each amplification Delta_m is unital and 2-positive, so positivity of the block matrix [[z* z,z*],[z,1]] gives Delta_m(z)*Delta_m(z)<=Delta_m(z* z), whence ||Delta_m(z)||^2<=||Delta_m(z* z)||<=||z* z|| after applying positivity and unitality to 0<=z* z<=||z||^2 1. Thus ||Delta||_cb<=1. At every matrix level, Phi Delta-Delta=(Phi-Delta Upsilon)Delta+Delta(Upsilon Delta-I_B), and therefore the triangle inequality, cb-norm submultiplicativity, and the two root bounds give ||Phi Delta-Delta||_cb<=epsilon+epsilon=2*epsilon. This establishes the needed estimate without using pending node 1.2.
